title: Clocked It! Jayda Cheaves Defends Son Loyal's Drip After Trolls Criticize His Jelly Sandals (VIDEO + PHOTOS) - NewsBreak
text: Jayda Cheaves is making it real clear that she doesn’t play when it comes to her son Loyal Armani . Sis came through with a response, checking folks who had something to say about the shoes Loyal was wearing in some new pics. The photos have been going viral on TikTok with folks sounding off and even dragging Jayda for putting Loyal in shoes they felt weren’t “boy appropriate.” Let’s get into it! In videos posted by LiveBitez , Jayda Cheaves clapped back at folks who started going in on Loyal’s shoes. The fashion and beauty influencer recently dropped some flicks from their mommy-son date, showing them grabbing food and then hiking. Not long after she posted, trolls came through with tons of comments, pressed about the sandals that Loyal had on. He rocked a colorful striped shirt, jeans, and white jelly sandals. Folks weren’t feeling it all, though. Some said the shoes were too risky for the outdoor activity, while others claimed they were more suitable for girls. And they didn’t stop there; they came for Jayda, too, saying her platform flip-flops weren’t hike-ready either. Well, Jayda didn’t waste time clocking the chatter, calling the folks who had something to say about Loyal “losers” and “weirdos.” She said nobody should care that much about someone else’s kid, especially a 6-year-old child. “When it comes to kids, I don’t even have the mental capacity to care.. unless someone is in danger or something like that. Other than that, I don’t give a fuck what a child is wearing, how they hair look. As they look clean and smart. That is all concerns me and that they are not in danger,” Jayda says in the clip. Meanwhile, folks in LiveBitez’s comment section had all kinds of opinions. Some even tried to drag Lil Baby into the mix, saying he also needs to step up and take accountability for Loyal’s style. Others kept it real simple, saying there was nothing wrong with Loyal’s fit and he should be able to rock whatever he wants. Instagram user @ undecided_shanee wrote, “ Y’all be worried bout the wrong thing go clean y’all house or something 😂 Instagram user @ _chocolate_drop30 wrote, “ ATP keep your child off the internet because ppl are going to speak their opinions in a cruel manner 😢” While Instagram user @ thefirstlaydee wrote, “ I agree! Because why are you so concerned! Yep! Mind your business..” Then Instagram user @_kayfinessed wrote, “Im lost, so when Caribbean &’ islander man wear sandles just like that its ok, but a lil boy wear them he’s fruity ? Hmmm 🤔🤔” Another Instagram user @ 442mee wrote, “ THERE’S NOTHING WRONG WITH HIS SHOES OR OUTFIT! 🙄” Instagram user @ gee_goldenwithin4x wrote, “ Why y’all so care so much, that’s the real question. He’s a child why sit in the comments worried that y’all are not raising? I swear it’s always us never them other races tear each other down.” While another Instagram user @daviddaughter68 wrote, “She needs to take accountability for what she is doing. I’m tired of her making excuses . I fault @lilbaby as well.” Instagram user @ relatablerelationtips wrote, She need to stop doing them get ready with me’s with that baby I see what they talking about. Yuntie tried to warn her. Baby come get your son!” Finally, Instagram user @ blancoshorty3 wrote, “ Mind y’all own kids !!!” Even though Jayda quickly checked the trolls coming for Loyal, she usually stays unbothered on social media, living it up with her baby boy. Fans eat up their viral moments every time. Most recently, they posted a clip from a lit car ride that turned into a freestyle session. Both of them started dropping bars, but Loyal definitely stole the show, he rapped about being the cutest baby and even told the haters they can’t talk to him. Peep the adorable video below.
